bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'STK_SHOP_EXISTING_RUNTIME='
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'cloudflare|caddy|nginx|traefik|pages|tunnel|gace|createvdobot' | sed -E 's/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/_/g' | head -n 35 | paste -sd ',' -
printf 'STK_SHOP_EXISTING_PROXY_SERVICE='
systemctl --user list-units --type=service --no-legend --no-pager | grep -Ei 'cloudflare|caddy|nginx|traefik|tunnel' | awk '{print $1}' | paste -sd ',' - || true
for s in createvdobot.g-acebot.com sticker.g-acebot.com g-acebot.com;do
 code="$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://$s/" 2>/dev/null || echo ERROR)"
 printf 'STK_SHOP_HTTPS_STATUS_%s=%s\n' "$s" "$code"
done
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
echo STK_SHOP_CURRENT_BOT_RUNNING=PASS
